For football clubs · iPhone

Film the match. Your phone runs the broadcast.

Kadar puts a live scoreboard, replays and graphics into the picture and streams your match to YouTube or Facebook. Or it just records to the phone. One volunteer, one iPhone, no laptop.

Matchday

On air in three steps

  1. Set up the match

    Three short screens: match details, the two teams with colours and logos, and where the stream goes. Clubs you saved are there next time.

  2. Start the broadcast

    Put the phone on a tripod, turn it sideways and go live. Or choose “Phone only” and record without streaming.

  3. Keep the score

    Tap +1 when a goal goes in. Start the clock, change halves, mark a moment as a highlight. The scoreboard in the picture follows.

What it does

A broadcast crew's job, on one screen

Built for the person who is watching the pitch, not the phone. Large buttons, controls that stay in place, and both ways of ending a broadcast ask first.

Free

Scoreboard and clock in the picture

Score, clock, halves, extra time and penalties are part of the video itself. They look the same on the stream and in the recording.

  • Eight scoreboard designs, six positions, four sizes. Change them while live. The extra designs are PRO.
  • Pause, End stream and End match are three separate buttons
  • A step back for a mistaken tap

PROPreview free

Replays with a caption

A goal or a highlight tap marks the moment. Watch it in a preview only you can see, then show the replay on the stream in a corner window while the live picture continues.

  • Caption under the replay: player, number, club and minute
  • Pinch the preview window to make it larger, or drag it to another corner
  • Showing the replay on the stream and the caption are PRO

PRONew

Spotlight on a player

Tap a player in the replay preview. The phone finds them in the picture and follows them through the clip, the rest dims and a ring marks their feet. The tapped frame stands still for a second so you see who was picked. Tap again to correct it.

New, and tried on a phone only briefly. It follows a player, not the ball. The picture is worked out on the phone itself.

PRONew

Clip studio: a video ready to post

After the match, open a highlight. Tap the player, fill in the caption and make the video. The light, the ring and the caption are written into the clip.

  • Caption plate with club colour, number, name, club and minute
  • A caption typed during the broadcast is already filled in
  • Share it or save it to Photos, ready for your club's social pages

New, and not yet tried on a phone with real players.

PRONew

Sponsors in the picture

A sponsor pop-up is a plate with the sponsor's logo and a line of text. It rises into a free corner of the picture, stays for 8 seconds and leaves. Your sponsors take turns.

  • Every 2, 5 or 10 minutes, or when you tap “Show one now”
  • It never covers the scoreboard, the LIVE sign, a replay or a full-picture slide
  • Also: sponsor logos by the scoreboard, a sliding text ticker and a full-picture slide for the break

Pop-ups are new. Checked in the simulator, not yet on a phone.

PRO

Leagues and cups

Type in the teams and choose a league, a knockout cup, or groups followed by a knockout. The schedule is made for you.

  • Stream a match straight from the schedule, with teams and round filled in
  • The result lands in the table by itself, and a cup winner moves on
  • Table, bracket, the round's matches and top scorers as full-picture graphics on the stream
  • Share the table or bracket as a picture

A competition is stored on the phone that created it. Two phones do not share one table yet.

Screenshots show the app in English with sample teams and a made-up sponsor. The app is also in Bosnian.

And the rest of the kit

  • PRO

    Prize draw on the stream

    Type the names and the prize. A reel spins through them and stops on the winner.

  • PRO

    Line-up on a pitch

    Pick a formation, tap players into position and show the starting eleven.

  • PRO

    Scoring from a second phone

    A colleague keeps the score and the clock from another phone with a short code.

  • Free

    Highlights by themselves

    Every goal and every marked moment becomes a clip. All of them are joined into one reel. Four result cards are ready to post.

  • Free

    Team sheet from a photo

    Photograph the team sheet and the players are read from it on the phone. Or type them in.

  • Free

    When the connection drops

    The app reconnects by itself, adjusts the picture to the connection and keeps recording to the phone meanwhile.

Free and PRO

Streaming with the scoreboard is free

PRO adds what makes it look like television: sponsors, replays on the stream, competitions and clips ready to post.

Free

  • Streaming to YouTube or Facebook
  • Scoreboard, clock and score control
  • Recording to the phone
  • Players, team-sheet scanning, highlights
  • Match history and result cards
  • Replay preview on your phone

PRO

Everything in Free, and:

  • TikTok, Instagram and custom RTMP
  • Extra scoreboard designs and editing team names
  • Sponsor pop-ups, sponsor logos, ticker, ad-break slide
  • Replay on the stream with a caption and a spotlight on a player
  • Clip studio: spotlight and caption on a highlight
  • Leagues and cups with their graphics
  • Line-up graphic, prize draw, scoring from a second phone
  • No Kadar watermark

Planned price for PRO at launch: €6.99 a month, or €49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial. You buy the subscription in the App Store, and the price shown there is the one that applies.

Straight answers

Questions clubs ask

Does it work on Android?

Not for streaming. Live streaming works on iPhone only. On Android the app can record a match but cannot stream it yet.

Where can I stream, and to how many places at once?

YouTube and Facebook are free. PRO adds TikTok, Instagram and any RTMP address. The phone streams to one of them at a time.

Which sports does it cover?

Football. Other sports are being prepared but are not switched on, so we do not promise them here.

Do I need extra equipment?

No. One iPhone does the filming, the graphics and the stream. A tripod and a charged battery make the afternoon easier.

What happens if the connection drops during the match?

The app tries to reconnect by itself and keeps recording to the phone in the meantime, so the match still ends up in your history with its highlights.

Does the spotlight follow the ball or analyse the match?

No. It follows the one player you tap in a replay or a highlight, and only for that clip. The app does not track the ball, and it does not produce tactics or player statistics.

Do I need an account?

No, the app works without one. An account (email and password) is there if you want it, and you can delete it in the app.

Can two phones run the same league?

Not yet. A competition lives on the phone that created it. You can share its table or bracket as a picture.

What does it cost?

Streaming with the scoreboard is free. PRO is planned at €6.99 a month or €49.99 a year with a 7-day free trial. The price in the App Store is the one that applies.

When can I get it?

Kadar is not in the App Store yet. Write to us and we will tell you when it is.
